== Title ==
<span lang="ja">コレリア人</span>. Three asterisks precede the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">各ターンに１回、武器／兵器かアイテムを１つ配備コスト－１（最低０）で同じ位置カード上の反乱軍に配備できる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ブリンディ・トルチョンは典型的なコレリア人女性の密輸屋だ。彼女はモス・アイズリーで、反乱軍に手っ取り早く物資を供給できる手段を探っている。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Corellian.

'''Lore''' — Brindy Truchong is a typical Corellian woman who smuggles. In Mos Eisley she is looking for a quick way to supply the Rebellion.

'''Game text''' — Once each turn, you may deploy one weapon or item on a Rebel at the same location card. Reduce its deploy cost by 1, to a minimum of 0.

Both faces give a minimum cost of zero. The Japanese uses アイテム for device and says location card where the English says site.<ref>[[:File:ANH-L-corellian.gif|Original English face]], [[Corellian]].</ref>
